UK freelancer tax calculator launched for 2025/26 estimates:

- Calculates Income Tax (with full Personal Allowance taper), Class 4 and Class 2 National Insurance, VAT threshold, and effective tax rates.
- Monitors VAT registration threshold (£90k) and provides MTD (Making Tax Digital) requirements and key deadlines.
- Accepts gross income and itemised or total expenses; categorises expenses per HMRC rules.
- Suits quick estimates, detailed annual or quarterly calculations, and scenario comparisons.
- Always outputs clear breakdowns, flags edge cases (e.g., approaching VAT, PA taper), and adds an estimate disclaimer.
